hook: The tower whose 34th floor was the site of the 1993 Pettit & Martin shooting.

building.completed_conflict: The assessor records 1983 (on file), but Wikipedia and the SPUR POPOS guide both record 1982 as the completion/plaza year.

permit_summary.note: DBI holds 2,086 permits for this parcel, most of them tenant improvements on individual floors. The timeline shows the 24 largest by stated cost, plus the earliest on file; the DBI query in the sources below returns all 2,086. 12 of them are nominal $1 street-space or sidewalk permits.

sections.heading: 1 July 1993
sections.body: A gunman entered the 34th-floor offices of the law firm Pettit & Martin and killed eight people and wounded six before killing himself. The killings were among the events that carried the federal Violent Crime Control and Law Enforcement Act of 1994 to passage.
